feedback: The candidate is the iteration 10 build (base_speed 1.4, kd 1.0, kp 3.5, sensors y 0.07 at x -0.04 to +0.04, sensor_size 0.012, line_loss last_direction) with one change: controller.base_speed 1.4 to 1.2. Geometry, kp, kd, sensor_weights and line_loss are unchanged, so the race isolates speed. Iteration 10 scored 457.99, the best raced design. Its oval finished 20 of 20 at 1.87 s, and the s-bend improved from progress 0.35 (iteration 9, base_speed 1.6) to 0.68 with 3 of 20 finishes, as speed fell. The slalom stayed flat at about 0.18 across every speed tried, so it is not speed-limited. The candidate is inside every contract limit and is not obviously broken. I make no claim about how it will perform. Approving now is justified because this is the final iteration, the 1.4 to 1.2 step is small and in the direction the evidence has supported, and the oval margin is large (about 2.1 s at 1.4, so roughly 2.3 s at 1.2, inside the 3.0 s limit). Iteration 10 remains the fallback if the next race shows a loss. Reducing speed cost no oval time from 1.6 to 1.4, so the completion-time penalty should be small.
